description: Repairs r-par-1/err-aggregate-and-groups: Errors was not cleared between statements. Asks at which call an erroring argument surfaces inside an aggregate (zm = 0 at id 100, zl = 0 at id 240, zf = 0 at id 3): Sum, Avg, Count, Min, Max of 1 / zm; Sum of 1 / zl and 1 / zf; Count(*) beside Sum(1 / zm); Sum with WHERE id <> 100, id < 100, id <= 100; derived tables with TOP 10, TOP 150 ORDER BY id and WHERE id < 50; and the grouped forms. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-par is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
